caption: The drawing features a wooden chest of drawers with a natural brown finish and visible wood grain. The chest has seven drawers arranged vertically, each fitted with metal handles; the handles are depicted in a brass-like color. The central vertical section of the drawers is decorated with carved floral and leaf motifs, while the surrounding drawer fronts are plain. Ornate carved columns with floral capitals flank the front corners of the chest. Both sides of the chest are paneled with rectangular designs. At the bottom left of the drawing, there are two detailed illustrations of metal casters, labeled as such, indicating the chest may be mobile. To the right of the chest is a technical line drawing showing a side view with hinges indicated, as well as a small plan detail view at the bottom, labeled "PLAN." The background of the drawing is a plain, light tan color.
title: Highboy
